mapper.insert: insert into user(id, openid, name, phone, sex, id_number, avatar, create_time) values (null,#{openid},#{name},#{phone},#{sex},#{idNumber},#{avatar},#{createTime})
mapper.select: select id, openid, name, phone, sex, id_number, avatar, create_time from user where openid = #{openid}
select id, openid, name, phone, sex, id_number, avatar, create_time from user where id = #{id}
